assignments.name: chatInput
assignments.value: Validate this listing: id bproperty-0, locality Dhanmondi, building type Apartment, area 2000 sqft, price 10000 BDT.

assignments.name: output
assignments.value: ={{ 'Cannot validate listing — ' + $json.parseErrors.join('; ') + '. Please provide: locality, building type, area (sqft), and price (BDT).' }}

parameters.query:
SELECT
  AVG(CAST(price AS DECIMAL(15,2)))        AS avg_price,
  STDDEV_POP(CAST(price AS DECIMAL(15,2))) AS std_price,
  AVG(CAST(area  AS DECIMAL(10,2)))        AS avg_area,
  STDDEV_POP(CAST(area  AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS std_area,
  COUNT(*) AS sample_size,
  '{{ $('Parse Listing Input').item.json.listingId }}'        AS listing_id,
  '{{ $('Parse Listing Input').item.json.localitySafe }}'     AS locality,
  '{{ $('Parse Listing Input').item.json.buildingTypeSafe }}' AS building_type,
  {{ $('Parse Listing Input').item.json.price }}              AS submitted_price,
  {{ $('Parse Listing Input').item.json.area }}               AS submitted_area
FROM properties
WHERE {{ $('Parse Listing Input').item.json.whereClause }};

parameters.text:
={{ 
'You are a helpful Bangladeshi real estate advisor. ' +
'A listing validation system has analysed a property listing and produced the structured result below. ' +
'Your job is to rewrite this result as a SHORT, friendly, plain-English explanation (3–6 sentences) for someone who knows nothing about statistics. ' +
'Rules:\n' +
'- NEVER mention z-scores, standard deviations, or any statistical jargon.\n' +
'- DO use clear comparisons like "X% above the neighbourhood average", "about twice the typical size", or "comparable to similar flats nearby".\n' +
'- If the verdict is OK, be reassuring but factual.\n' +
'- If the verdict is FLAGGED, explain simply why it looks unusual and suggest the buyer double-check before proceeding.\n' +
'- If there are no comparables, say so plainly (e.g. "We don\'t have enough similar listings in this area to compare against yet.").\n' +
'- If the sample is small, add a gentle caveat.\n' +
'- End with one practical next-step recommendation.\n\n' +
'Structured result (JSON):\n' +
$json.llmContext
}}
